title: Himalayan Solar IPO Details
intro:
Himalayan Solar IPO is a book build issue of ₹68.03 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 58.91 lakh shares aggregating to ₹60.68 crores and offer for sale of 7.14 lakh shares aggregating to ₹7.35 crores.

Himalayan Solar IPO opens for subscription on Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Sep 29, 2026. The allotment for the Himalayan Solar IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 30, 2026. Himalayan Solar IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 5, 2026.

Himalayan Solar IPO is set issue price band at ₹98 to ₹103 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,47,200 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,70,800.

Finshore Management Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Anant Securities

Refer to Himalayan Solar IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2015, Himalayan Solar Limited is specializes in providing integrated turnkey solar energy solutions offering services including design, manufacturing, supply, installation, and commissioning of wide range of solar products, with a primary focus on Solar Water Pumping Systems. They provide solar energy solutions for Solar Inverter Charge Systems and Solar Rooftop Power Systems.

As on March 31, 2026, the company has implemented more than 85000 HP capacity of Solar Water Pumping Systems as part of Government Projects in India. As of Mar 31, 2026, its Polycrystalline Solar PV Modules manufacturing capacity stood at 40 MW corresponding to 1,19,000 nos. of Polycrystalline Solar PV Module and Mono PERC solar PV Modules manufacturing capacity stood at 60 MW equivalent to approximately 1,07,500 nos. of 555W-560W Mono PERC Solar PV Modules annually.
As on July 31, 2026, the Company have employed 87 employees.
strengths: Experienced Promoters backed by a strong management team
Strong Presence in Government-Focused Renewable Energy Projects Across Multiple States
Strong relationship with customers and suppliers.
Ability to implement our Solar Products portfolio is Government-backed Solar Projects as supplemental value addition along with their manufacturing business.

faqs.question: How to apply in Himalayan Solar IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Himalayan Solar IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Himalayan Solar IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Himalayan Solar IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Himalayan Solar IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Himalayan Solar IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Himalayan Solar IPO opens on Fri, Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 29, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Himalayan Solar IPO?
faqs.answer: Himalayan Solar IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,47,200 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Himalayan Solar IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Himalayan Solar IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Himalayan Solar IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Himalayan Solar IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 1, 2026 . Check the Himalayan Solar IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Himalayan Solar IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Himalayan Solar IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Oct 5, 2026 .
